groups.problem: The migration stores legacy hosts without stripping schemes and paths, so migrated hosts fail subsequent host lookups.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same raw migration insert bypassing host normalization. S15 mentions SQL escaping only as part of its proposed fix.

groups.problem: Update and destroy dereference missing host records, returning errors instead of handling unknown IDs.
groups.rationale: Each reports the same unchecked lookup results in the same two controller actions.

groups.problem: The new controller specs only check inheritance and provide no request behavior coverage.
groups.rationale: Both files repeat the same inheritance-only testing pattern. Each needs behavioral request specs for its respective controller.

groups.problem: The category and embeddable-host fabricator files contain each other's definitions.
groups.rationale: These describe opposite sides of the same file-content swap; moving the definitions to their matching files resolves all three.

groups.problem: Host normalization calls sub! on a potentially nil host, crashing validation.
groups.rationale: All identify the same missing nil guard in before_validation. S21's observation about sub! return values is a clarity suggestion, not another reported failure.

problems: The migration dereferences query results without checking whether any rows exist.

uncoveredProblems: Unchecked empty query results can abort the migration; S17 also reports this, but there are insufficient single-problem suggestions to form a group.
